data.long_meaning: Rahul is a common name among Hindus, derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rahul' meaning 'friend'. The name Singh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Singha' meaning 'lion'. So, Rahulsingh means 'Ruler of the Gods, Lion-king'. The name Rahulsingh carries the meaning “Ruler of the Gods” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Rahulsingh usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler of the gods and live with faith, good character and purpose.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Rahul was the name of a famous Jain monk and philosopher who lived around the 1st century BCE. The name Rahulsingh carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Rahul was one of the 14 great disciples of Mahavira, the 24th Tirthankara of Jainism. He was also the youngest son of King Bharat in the Nandivardhana dynasty. Rahul is known for his deep spiritual understanding and his debates with other philosophers.

historical_references.reference: Rahul Singh was a prominent figure in the 13th century in Northern India and was the founder of the Sangamera dynasty.
historical_references.context: Rahul Singh was a Rajput ruler who ruled over the region of Hansi in present-day Haryana. He is known for his military conquests and his patronage of art and culture. The Sangamera dynasty he founded continued to rule the region for several centuries.
